title: Explicit source Weil pullback intertwining a Frobenius power
statement: Let $k_0,k_1$ be finite fields and $\ell$ a prime invertible in both. Let $X/k_0$ and $C/k_1$ be locally finite-type schemes, with geometric fibres $\bar X,\bar C$ [def-pc-base-change]. Let $r\in\mathbb N$ and $u:\bar C\to\bar X$ satisfy $u\circ\operatorname{Fr}_C=\operatorname{Fr}_X^r\circ u$. Define $P:\operatorname{Weil}(X,k_0,\ell)\to\operatorname{Weil}(C,k_1,\ell)$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex] by iterating the given Weil map $r$ times and then applying adic inverse image along $u$ with the canonical Frobenius commutation. Its underlying adic sheaf is $u^*G$. This explicit functor preserves finite limits, finite colimits, and lissity [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves]; its cokernel comparison is an isomorphism. For a Weil sheaf $H$ on $C$, geometric simplicity of its carrier implies arithmetic lisse simplicity. Here simplicity means nonzero lisse with no proper nonzero lisse subobject. Moreover, for a scheme isomorphism $z:D\simeq E$ and an adic sheaf $M$ on $E$, simplicity of $z^*M$ implies simplicity of $M$. The functor is constructed from the iterated Weil map, not chosen from an unspecified existence claim.

proof.text: Compose the explicitly defined source powFunctor with IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIso applied to the adic inverse-image commutation isomorphism. Restrict to constructible objects by preservation of constructibility. Exactness follows from exactness of these two functors and the fully faithful constructible inclusion. This construction and its properties are completely proved in Lean. A generic cokernel comparison with abstract category data is exposed as a named isomorphism, so consumers do not expand the power construction to identify the quotient. The proved existence interface returns this very functor, with its defining equality and exactness properties; the equality determines its witness and lets consumers keep the construction abstract.

proof.text: The carrier equation and preservation of lissity follow from inverse image. For geometric simplicity, forget a lisse monomorphism to the exact carrier functor and use geometric simplicity; the forgetful functors reflect zero objects and isomorphisms. For a scheme isomorphism use the fully faithful inverse-image equivalence. These properties are proved in Lean. Expose the composite-restriction and Weil-isomorphism simplicity consequences as proved API lemmas, with schemes and sheaves abstract; this avoids expanding model and cokernel data in their consumers.
